args.text:
Batch: 25 runs. 6 accepted (r05, r13, r16, r17, r19, r24), 6 declined (r04, r09, r10, r11, r15, r22), 13 not reported.
Flagged: none.
Cleared: all 6 accepted runs.
- All 6 pass rigid-body invariance (0.44–0.82 %/h, threshold 2.0) and closure (0.06–0.45 px/h, threshold 1.0).
- Their centre REGR peaks are 41.97–42.51 %/h, all at 316 µm from the tip, with growth zones of 526–547 µm. Every summary has |z| ≤ 1.4.
- All 6 report the width-free ratio. In r05, r13, r16, r19 and r24, plane sections is just above its threshold (3.43–3.86 vs 3.25 %/h), but this check is not run under the width-free ratio. These five kept only the width-free remedy. Their largest flank difference is about −3.5 %/h and their largest width-free ratio about −0.45, both within the batch spread.
- r17 also kept frame registration on the non-growing tissue. Registration plus the width-free ratio made its checks pass, which is the normal path.
Since no run was flagged, there is no common pattern among flagged runs. Batch context: the declined runs and most not-reported runs failed rigid invariance and closure by wide margins. Their strain-rate profiles differ from the batch: REGR peak 51–173 %/h, peak position 116–842 µm and growth zone 11–400 µm.
